responsibility: Declares the expression-specific lowering visitors used by the Rust front end’s AST-to-HIR phase. It provides separate translators for expression paths, qualified expression paths, and general expressions, with the main ASTLoweringExpr class exposing overrides for the broad set of AST expression variants and carrying the translated HIR::Expr result, temporary array-element lowering state, and termination tracking. This header is the interface that other lowerers use when they need to lower a subexpression into HIR.
same_name_distinction: Declares the expression-focused lowering classes ASTLoweringExpr, ASTLowerPathInExpression, and ASTLowerQualPathInExpression; the companion rust-ast-lower-expr.cc provides their visit-method implementations that actually build HIR expression and path nodes.
